corrected_code:
from litestar import Controller, get, Request
from litestar.di import Provide
from litestar.exceptions import NotFoundException, NotAuthorizedException

class MedicalScanController(Controller):
    path = "/imaging/scans"

    @get(path="/{scan_id:str}/findings")
    async def get_scan_findings(
        self,
        scan_id: str,
        request: Request,
        imaging_repo: ScanRepository
    ) -> list[ScanFinding]:
        scan = await imaging_repo.get_by_id(scan_id)
        if not scan:
            raise NotFoundException(detail="Medical scan not found")
        if not await imaging_repo.can_access_patient(user_id=request.user.id, patient_id=scan.patient_id):
            raise NotAuthorizedException(detail="Forbidden: insufficient clinical privileges for patient scan")
        return scan.findings
